lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 이 지역 산업을 조사하러 왔습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Hello. I came to research the industries in this area.
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. i jiyeok saneobeul josahareo watseumnida.
lines.learner: 네, 반가워요. 요즘 여기 사정이 많이 어려워요.
lines.en: Yes, nice to meet you. Things are really hard here lately.
lines.roman: ne, bangawoyo. yojeum yeogi sajeongi mani eoryeowoyo.

lines.en: Far from going well, many people are giving up their fields.

lines.learner: 비료 값이 올라서 농작물을 키우기 힘들어요.
lines.en: Fertilizer prices went up, so it's hard to grow crops.
lines.roman: biryo gapsi ollaseo nongjangmureul kiugi himdeureoyo.

lines.learner: 밭에서 곡물과 유기농 채소를 키우는데 힘들어요.
lines.en: We grow grain and organic vegetables in the fields, but it's tough.
lines.roman: bateseo gongmulgwa yuginong chaesoreul kiuneunde himdeureoyo.

lines.learner: 목장도 사료 값 때문에 가축을 줄이고 있어요.
lines.en: Ranches are cutting livestock because of feed prices too.
lines.roman: mokjangdo saryo gap ttaemune gachugeul jurigo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: So livestock is struggling too. Are there any big businesses?
lines.learner: 큰 사업체는 금속 가공 공장 하나뿐이에요.
lines.en: The only big business is one metal processing factory.
lines.roman: keun saeopcheneun geumsok gagong gongjang hanappunieyo.

lines.learner: 원자재 값이 올라서 매출이 늘기는커녕 줄었어요.
lines.en: Raw material prices rose, so far from growing, sales dropped.
lines.roman: wonjajae gapsi ollaseo maechuri neulgineunkeonyeong jureosseoyo.

lines.learner: 건설은 멈췄고 새로 여는 가게도 없어요.
lines.en: Construction has stopped, and no new shops are opening.
lines.roman: geonseoreun meomchwotgo saero yeoneun gagedo eopseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Are there any big company branches here?
lines.learner: 제과 회사 지점이 있었는데 작년에 문을 닫았어요.
lines.en: There was a confectionery company branch, but it closed last year.
lines.roman: jegwa hoesa jijeomi isseonneunde jangnyeone muneul dadasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you for sharing. I'll be sure to include it in my report.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 우리 마을에 도움이 되면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: Thank you. I hope it helps our village.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. uri maeure doumi doemyeon jokesseoyo.
